subject: Enable ASan runs for OSS integ tests (#330)
reason: The change modifies only build/CI scripts (build.sh, integration/run.sh, testing/integration/run.sh, scripts/common.rc) and Python integration-test scaffolding (test_info.py skip marker, LOGS_DIR handling in valkey_search_test_case.py) to enable ASan for OSS integration tests. No module source code is touched, so the valkey-search module's runtime behaviour — commands, replies, indexing, persistence — is identical on both builds; there is no changed path a scenario could reach and no reply that could legitimately differ between the change and its parent.
